summary_markdown:
### Beacon onboarding
- SSO login step moves before workspace naming

### Tooltip pattern and priority list and slack thread
- Tooltip pattern is a moving target
  - Suggestion to do a quick spike before touching tooltip pattern
  - Tooltip pattern is hard to reason about
- Priority list is a bit of a black box
- Slack thread is the blocker
  - Real issue may be first-run experience rather than slack thread
  - Slack thread: i couldn't reproduce it
  - Notes on slack thread added to the doc
- Preference to make it someone's job rather than revisit it next cycle

### Metrics and avatar treatment and empty state
- Metrics is bigger than we scoped
  - Metrics is pretty solid
- Avatar treatment is good enough for now
  - Notes on avatar treatment added to the doc
- Notes on empty state added to the doc
  - Empty state is way overdue
- Preference to get more data rather than draw it on a whiteboard

### Color tokens and dashboard cards and search results page
- Feedback on color tokens from the data folks: they pushed back a bit
- Dashboard cards: i got kind of lost
  - Dashboard cards is in a weird spot
- Search results page is in good shape

### Icon set and nav and communication plan
- Icon set is way more complicated than it looks
- Nav is hard to reason about
- No clear owner for communication plan

### Onboarding flow and spreadsheet
- Onboarding flow is in a weird spot
- Spreadsheet is the easy part
